summary: Tire force/torque computation: when the enable byte field this+0x1EC is set, computes torque *a5 from a bias-scaled quadratic model of inputs a2/a3 and three force components a4[0..2] (two absolute-value terms and one quadratic term); when disabled, zeroes all four outputs. Returns the force output pointer a4.

operations.description: Enable guard: byte field this+0x1EC non-zero selects the compute path, zero selects the zero-output path under the thiscall ABI lead.
Torque output *a5 = (a3 + bias field this+0x2E8) * scale field this+0x228 + a2*a2*field this+0x220 + a2*field this+0x218 + field this+0x210 (quadratic + bias model).
Force component a4[2] = a2*a2*field this+0x208 + a2*field this+0x200 + field this+0x1F8 (quadratic in a2).
Disabled path: zero torque *a5 and all force components a4[0..2].
